name: Diesel Laptops
description: Diagnostic kits for truck and off-highway mechanics: a laptop, software, and cables, plus repair information, its own software, and tech support. Sold to repair shops and fleets. It started as eBay bundles in 2012. Irmo, South Carolina.

mentions.evidence: Self-reported, Starter Story, 18 December 2018. Not independently checked. Sales were $3.5 million in 2015, almost $8 million in 2016, and $16 million in 2017. The page headline says $20 million a year, and the header says $4.2 million of revenue a month and 180 employees. Those header figures are as shown on the page, not the 2017 sales line. Over $1 million that year on paid search. Profitable, with every penny reinvested. This is a 2018 interview.
mentions.indieAngle: The hardware kit is the sale. The software and the repair data on top of it are the part that can recur.

whyItPrints: Shops pay $2,000 to $8,000 or more for a tool that saves technician hours. Support and updates are why they keep buying. Leads come from paid search at about $50 for a high-quality lead, and most sales close by phone.
whyThisMatters:
Diesel Laptops sells the kit a truck shop uses when a computer has to talk to the engine. A laptop, software, cables, repair information, and a person on support. Off-highway equipment is in the same pile. It started as bundles on eBay in 2012, in Irmo, South Carolina.

The interview is from December 2018. Sales in the story are three and a half million in 2015, almost eight million in 2016, and sixteen million in 2017. The page headline says twenty million a year, and the header says a monthly figure with a hundred and eighty employees. Those header lines are what the page shows. They are not the 2017 sales sentence. Shops pay a few thousand dollars, sometimes more, because a technician hour is expensive. Paid search was over a million in the year he is talking about, at about fifty dollars for a lead worth calling. Most sales close on the phone. Profitable, and he says every penny went back in.

You pay for a tool that diagnoses the truck, and then you pay to keep the software and the support current. This is not a seat on a website.
